title: PPT Master deck authored here, built and opened on the machine

steps.why: author the deck's pages from THIS repo's numbers - fast, no install, catches layout bugs before a round is spent
the repo's own gate list (code/gates.json) - the same questions check_all.sh asks

the whole local plane on Linux/macOS in one step: code/pptmaster_local.sh finds a python 3.10+, clones ppt-master if it is missing, builds the venv + core deps, runs the pipeline (pages authored here -> svg_quality_checker -> svg_to_pptx -> structural re-check -> pptx_delivery_check) and proves a real application can open the file with LibreOffice headless; the receipt it writes is what this runner then asserts

note: The default test task of this repo (docx/pptx + a native pptx deck). The task itself is NOT part of the runner: copy this file, change the steps, and the same loop drives a different repo's task. Which deck (generator/project/output) comes from code/pptmaster_deck.json.
